description: GRID3 Data Hub is an open data portal listed in GRID3 Data Hub, a geospatial data hub, published or maintained by GRID3 (Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development). GRID3 Data Hub is a geospatial data hub of GRID3 (Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development). Coverage: sub-Saharan Africa. 331 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 4 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-grid3-portal.
